name: 演化契约与零擅自向后兼容

question.instructions: Evaluate compliance with Evolution Contract and State Lifecycle Invariants: (1) zero unapproved backward compatibility, clean deprecation, removal of dead/deprecated code, and consistency with any Documented Design Context; (2) state-machine invariants must stay closed across transitions—removing targets from desired/mirrored sets, disabling features, or entering EXCLUDED/FAILED phases must immediately invalidate downstream readiness and seal stale timestamps/epochs so old evidence cannot resurrect readiness.

criteria.passed: Complies with clean deprecation and documented architecture (dead code and unapproved fallbacks deleted); maintains closed lifecycle invariants across removal, disablement, failure, and recovery transitions so stale or excluded state can never serve as ready. Security redaction guards and intentional trade-offs explained in Documented Design Context (AGENTS.md/docs/) are acceptable.
criteria.violated: Violates rule: unapproved deprecated code, zombie backward-compatible fallback, dual-track compatibility layer, implementation contradicting docs/, or broken lifecycle invariant (e.g., removed/disabled/excluded targets remaining ready, or stale timestamps/evidence resurrecting invalidated state).

why: 核心正交架构红线：未经批准禁留向后兼容与死代码；状态生命周期变更必须保证“移除/停用即失效、历史证据不可回退”等核心不变量闭环。
